comments.body:
Here is an updated integration test that should pass, once this ticket has been resolved:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/compare/master...awoods:fcrepo-3268?expand=1

Yes here is an original tsv

> cat fedoraToOcflIndex.tsv.original
info:fedora/ info:fedora/ _fedora_repository_root
info:fedora/binary1 info:fedora/binary1 binary1
info:fedora/binary1/fcr:metadata info:fedora/binary1 binary1

and here is the rebuild

> cat fedoraToOcflIndex.tsv.rebuild
null null binary1
info:fedora/binary1/fcr:metadata null binary1
info:fedora/binary1 null binary1
info:fedora/ info:fedora/ _fedora_repository_root

Jared Whiklo: you should be good to go:
https://github.com/whikloj/fcrepo4/pull/7

This was the key: https://github.com/whikloj/fcrepo4/pull/7/files#diff-f210045277d54842209f1d5631554535R50

renderedFields.description:
This bug can be seen in the following scenario:

  1. Start fedora
    java -jar fcrepo-webapp/target/fcrepo-webapp-6.0.0-SNAPSHOT-jetty-console.jar --headless
  2. Create a binary resource
    curl -XPOST -H"Slug: binary1" -H"Content-type: text/plain" --data-binary "This is some text" http://localhost:8080/rest
  3. Verify that retrieval of resource works
    curl -i http://localhost:8080/rest/binary1
  4. Verify that retrieval of resource description works
    curl -i http://localhost:8080/rest/binary1/fcr:metadata
  5. Stop fedora
  6. Remove the index
    rm /tmp/fcrepo.ocfl.work.dir/fedoraToOcflIndex.tsv (or wherever it is configured to be located)
  7. Start fedora
  8. Verify that retrieval of resource works
    curl -i http://localhost:8080/rest/binary1 - BOOM!
  9. Verify that retrieval of resource description works
    curl -i http://localhost:8080/rest/binary1/fcr:metadata - BOOM!
